theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only fully eligible theme with a strongly positive score and the highest durability bar (0.54). The one-narrative structure with an absorption of 0.48 and breadth of only 0.385 means the theme's leadership is concentrated but not yet diffused. The documented validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, and Banks passes that gate while almost everything else fails eligibility — in a defensive, gate-helps-true regime, holding the only eligible leader is the most accountable directional expression. Rank-IC is ~0 so this is a staying-power/risk lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Banks carries a mean-revert Hurst tag, suggesting the leadership itself is not trend-persistent; the detector's own verdict is discipline-not-prediction, and the rank-IC is ~0, so there is no forward-return edge — only gate-based drawdown control. If the gate flips Banks to ineligible, the entire case collapses.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: Conglomerates & Exchange is the only other eligible theme in the universe (rank 4, score 0.738, durability 0.5). Its durability bar is the second-highest among eligible names. In a gate-helps-true regime where only 2 of 17 themes qualify, this is the only remaining compliant expression besides Banks. Crowding is absent (z=0.29), so no sizing caution applies. This is a defensive, gate-compliant lean rather than an alpha call.
theses.dissent: Score is less than half Banks' score and the durability is lower; Hurst is mixed rather than trend, so persistence is uncertain. With only 12% of themes eligible, this is a narrow, fragile regime where a single shake-out could remove the theme from eligibility.
